newsitem.title: GERMANY: Preussag boosted by steel takeover talks.
newsitem.headline: Preussag boosted by steel takeover talks.

text.p: Positive sentiment generated by merger mania in its rivals boosted shares in German engineering firm Preussag AG nearly four percent on Wednesday in mid-session bourse trade.

Preussag shares were up 17.30 marks, or 3.95 percent, at 455.00 marks, slightly off earlier highs. This compared well to the overall market which was up 12.04 points, or 0.37 percent, at 3,303.23 points.
"You have to have steel, and Preussag is the best steel stock on offer," a trader said.
Mannesmann also received a lift from positive sentiment in the steel sector, up nearly two percent at 631 marks.
Focus has centred on the steel industry since Fried. Krupp AG's launched a 13.6 billion mark takeover for Thyssen AG. Since then Krupp has proposed cooperation talks with Thyssen.
